text:
jess: quick ping — small PR up that touches auth-proxy config + k8s env handling, no plaintext secrets. https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4823 :wave:

sam: link looks good. does this change any ENV propagation for on-prem/vpc customers? worried about accidental env leakage to sidecars.

jess: good call — it narrows the service account scope and adds an explicit allowlist for sidecar envs. single-line change in `auth/proxy/env_filter.go`. also wired KMS envelope keys for the credential blob. no plaintext in config.

owen: can you paste the diff for the env filter? quick glance would help me approve. also what merge window are you aiming for?

jess: diff snippet:
```go
// filter envs to only these prefixes for sidecars
allowed := []string{"RW_", "REDWOOD_"}
// rest dropped from sidecar injection
```
Planning to merge in tomorrow's 11:00–11:30am UTC merge window if sec + privacy sign off.

maria: @jess @sam quick checklist from privacy: are we logging any raw credential metadata anywhere? audit logs need to be scrubbed and we should add a note to the privacy-runbook.

jess: @maria no raw creds in logs — only key IDs and masked blob sizes. added a privacy-runbook note in the PR description and linked the audit log grep we added.

sec-bot: automated checks: dependency-scan: passed, secret-scan: passed, infra-policy: warning — missing KMS key rotation tag (policy-id: infra-rot-21). See CI details: https://ci.internal/redwood/4823

sam: thanks for the followup. KMS rotation tag is a policy requirement — can we add the tag in the same PR or is that a separate infra change?

jess: I'll add the rotation tag to the KMS alias in a quick follow-up commit in this PR. it's just metadata: `rotation=30d`.

owen: LGTM from infra side once the tag is added. I'll do the canary rollout and monitor latency for 30m. please add a health-check smoke command in the PR description so I can run it during canary.

jess: added `curl -sS https://canary.internal/health | jq .status` to the PR description. also added a tiny unit test for `env_filter` per @sam's earlier note.

sam: thanks — +1 from me for security changes. please still wait for @maria privacy ack before merge. :thumbsup:

maria: privacy acked. verified audit log change and runbook note. :eyes:

jess: awesome — merging in the 11:00 UTC window and will monitor. tagging the deploy: `deploy/patch-4823-canary`. ping me if you see anything unusual. :rocket:

owen: will watch metrics and report back in this thread after 30m.

sec-bot: deploy scheduled for 11:07 UTC, canary group: 5% traffic, monitoring hooks attached.

owen: canary healthy after 30m. no error rate increase, latency within baseline. merging to main per plan.

jess: merged at 11:38 UTC and backfilled the KMS tag commit. thanks all.
